title: Longest Substring with At Most Two Distinct Characters
prompt: Given a string `s`, return the length of the longest substring that contains at most two distinct characters.

examples.explanation: The substring "ece" has length 3 with 2 distinct characters, 'e' and 'c'.
The substring "aabbb" has length 5 with 2 distinct characters, 'a' and 'b'.

hints: Checking every substring for the distinct-character-count constraint independently is O(n^2) or worse.
Use a sliding window with a hash map counting occurrences of each character currently inside it.

Expand the window to the right, and whenever the map has more than 2 distinct keys, shrink from the left (decrementing counts, deleting a key once it hits zero) until only 2 remain, tracking the max window length seen.

solution.approach: Maintain a sliding window with a hash map from character to its count inside the window. Expand the window by moving right and updating the map. Whenever the map holds more than 2 distinct characters, shrink from the left, decrementing the count of the character leaving and removing it from the map entirely once its count reaches zero, until at most 2 distinct characters remain. Track the maximum window length seen throughout.
solution.spaceComplexity: O(1) (at most 3 keys tracked at any time)
